metadata.description:
J. William Fulbright Speaking On The Need To Rebuild Educational Systems Destroyed By The Nazis, Ca. 1943 "This is a sound recording of J. William Fulbright, Congressman from Arkansas and U.S. delegate to the Conference of Allied Ministers of Education, as he spoke of Nazi destruction of educational facilities in conquered countries, the need to help conquered peoples reconstruct their educational systems when they are liberated, and congressional support of the Conference."
